info.name: Grand Line – One Piece Google Theme
info.description: A One Piece-inspired Google theme bringing the world of the Straw Hat Pirates to your browser. Featuring deep ocean blues, Luffy-inspired red accents, golden treasure details, and a mysterious Grand Line atmosphere. Set sail and explore!
info.additionalInfo: A One Piece-inspired Google theme featuring deep ocean colors, Luffy-inspired red accents, and golden treasure details.
